patterns: Several kc-statement outputs return a verdict without the required statement; these lose materially to any correct explicit statement.
For dense task-generation passages, coverage differences are decisive: omitting multiple taught parameters is material even when the retained tasks are correct.
Self-containment is a recurring discriminator: tasks that ask for a concrete vector without supplying the vocabulary or documents are not answerable as written.
More tasks are not automatically better; redundant or combined demands reduce assessment quality, while factual inconsistency in an answer outweighs concision.
